files.producer_consumer_binding_and_missing_st: Trusted run/workflow/head/attempt plus complete guard jobs -> existing status context; rejects ambiguous/missing provenance. Evidence: source lines and agents-guard fork status publication tests.

Merged PR/source/CI API records -> authoritative verifier input. Wrapper/run attempt, head, workflow path, complete pagination and merge-CI checks are explicit. Missing/partial inputs are diagnostics, never verification success; failing merge CI floors the provider instruction. This is input capture, not completed acceptance. Evidence: agents-verifier-context.test.js.

Issue labels -> hasVerify -> resolveCurrentState. Closed + verify:evaluate maps to closed-verified/done even with no linked PR; the label is request bookkeeping rather than a verdict or source-bound acceptance. Missing merged PR still yields done; pending request is treated as acceptance.
Task progress/runner lifecycle, including terminal state; unchecked tasks or a stop marker are not post-merge provider acceptance. Evidence: keepalive_loop.js:3467,6161.
Records finding-level sync disposition; retained finding identity and evidence are distinct from original source acceptance. Evidence: maint71_finding_verification.js:37,207,215.
Sync merger delegates to the sync contract/check/review floor; verifier verdict naming is reporting, not the only merge gate. Evidence: maint71_merge_sync_prs.js:2194.

Campaign evidence bookkeeping for source-owned delivery; no new implementation admission or original product acceptance comes from verdict text alone. Evidence: sync_dependency_campaign.js:621-640,2058.
Classifies controlled sync provenance and policy; unrelated verifier prose is not source-delivery authorization. Evidence: sync_pr_merge_contract.js:781,785.

Explicit workflow inputs -> terminal/outcome records. Pure classification/serialization recognizes verdicts but cannot prove the supplied run/source identity. The caller must supply and validate binding and settlement; source3969 owns caller-sink negative coverage, not a change to this serializer in this audit.

Trusted caller verdict + merge SHA + source-body plan -> closureDecision/closeVerifiedSources. Source hash and plan head must match; CI entries must match merge SHA. Non-PASS remains refused except explicitly checked UNVERIFIABLE_INPUT deterministic-gate rule; no blanket PASS synthesis. Evidence: verifier-closure.test.js.
Converts parsed findings into issue text. Unknown verdicts remain unknown in content; this formatter does not perform source closure. Evidence: verifier-issue-formatter.test.js.
Structured report serialization used by verifier workflows; does not discover or authorize a source PR. Evidence: verifier_verdict_json.py module docstring and serializers.
Comment/label intake routing; verification label is a requested next step, not accepted delivery. Evidence: agents-63-issue-intake.yml:1163.

Issue label reader supplies hasVerify; the verify step records verify:evaluate on an issue when no merged source is found. Root/template share the known request-versus-completion error, not an additional independent defect. Missing/stale: issue-only label still completes.
Current PR check/status gate; a verdict string is not a post-merge source-acceptance transition. Fork status publication is separately identity-bound. Evidence: agents-guard.yml:1034,1162,1166.

Merged-PR/exact-label or authorized dispatch caller -> reusable verifier. Label requests work; it does not certify PASS. API merge checks and trusted helper checkout protect the boundary. Evidence: agents-verifier.yml:6,88,197.

Linked issue/PR extraction and posted report text -> terminal helper -> issue-only follow-up. Same report parser boundary as the new-PR path; missing data blocks, but stale terminal text needs the existing parser repair and a call-path regression.

PR/comment collection -> verification_data.txt -> terminal helper -> follow-up eligibility. Empty/missing and recognized pending reports block. Text parsers do not by themselves prove latest attempt/source binding; the known historical report defect propagates here. Do not interpret a created follow-up as original acceptance.
Credential health verdict is not a product verifier verdict or merged-source acceptance. Evidence: health-muse-auth-check.yml:70.
Historical corpus collection for evaluation; no live source-closure transition. Evidence: maint-79-verifier-corpus-harvest.yml:86.
Current-head CI summary and requested verification context; CI green is a product-check result, not provider/source acceptance. Evidence: pr-00-gate.yml:1298,1435-1464.

Context capture + provider output -> settlement -> metrics, terminal artifact, ledger and source closure. Source/merge bindings are captured upstream; skipped/missing settlement and explicit CI failures must not produce PASS at a terminal sink. Existing source3969/PR4124 owns this concrete remaining seam; audit does not assume its open payload is deployed.

VerificationData + verdict_policy -> scoped follow-up content/disposition. A generator is not source acceptance; preserves non-PASS and split-policy inputs rather than establishing PR/attempt identity. Caller terminal/source admission remains mandatory. Evidence: verdict-policy and follow-up generation tests; no closure transition in this module.

Captured diff/criteria -> structured provider result/report. Parser/repair stages distinguish partial output from terminal reports; provider verdict remains evidence, not permission to close an unrelated source. Input identity is the caller/context boundary; no source-closure mutation from a parsed verdict here. Evidence: pr_verifier.py provider result construction.
Parsed report/provider verdicts -> policy CLI outputs, including needs_human. It is a report adapter, not a merged-source or terminal-attempt authorization. Evidence: verdict_extract.py:1-91.

Provider verdict records -> deterministic policy result. This value policy cannot establish freshness/source identity and is not used as an identity validator. Missing/unknown/split values have explicit policy handling. Evidence: verdict_policy.py and its unit tests.

Posted report text -> artifact_from_verification_text -> follow-up terminal gate. Verdict extraction scans all history before the latest report is selected. Old PASS plus newer incomplete text lacking the repair phrases returns terminal=True. Missing text fails closed; recognized pending repair fails closed. No source/attempt identity is validated by this parser.
